tour_grabAndSelectText: Use the hand tool to move around the canvas. Switch to the pointer (1) tool to select elements or drag to select multiple.
tour_shapeToolsText: This square (2) tool and the icons next to it - diamond (3) and circle (4) - let you draw basic shapes for diagrams and layouts.
tour_lineAndPenToolsText: The arrow (5) tool connects ideas, the line (6) adds straight connectors, and the pen (7) lets you sketch freeform lines or notes.
tour_contentToolsText: The text (8) tool lets you label your sketch, and the image (9) tool next to it lets you insert pictures or references onto the canvas.
tour_eraserToolText: Click the eraser (0) once on any element to remove it. You can't drag to erase — one click per item.
tour_openMenuText: Click the hamburger menu icon to access extra options like exporting your work.
tour_exportingYourSketchesText: From the menu, select Export image (or press Cmd + Shift + E) to open export options. Click Next to continue.
tour_saveAsAnImageText: Choose the PNG option to save your canvas as an image. You'll use this later to share with the AI Tutor.
tour_moveOnToNextLevelTitle: Move on to the next level
tour_moveOnToNextLevelText: When you're done with your Sketch Lab creation, click Continue to move on to the next level.
